stop_reason: Grouped replay raised positive energy without a reservation; formal deadline reached before a rerun.

market.foresight: All tasks and native prices within the solved week are known.

execution.recovery_scope: Read and settle archived witnesses without a new solve.

offline_evidence.note: Each path is relative to the offline run directory. The archived sweep terminated before its native summary. publication_recovery.json was built from the verified solve records. Each solve ID in either manifest corresponds to <id>.json.gz in the same folder.

model_policy.service: Whole truck-day maximum, then maximum overlap with the registered cohort.
model_policy.dispatch: Minimize wholesale electricity at each pair of 15-minute caps, then settle replayed meter traces and choose the cheapest scanned invoice.
model_policy.decision_scope: Keep each cap within installed power. A cap can be below the hardware's instantaneous limit.
model_policy.delta_0_matrix: Pool interchangeable complete quarters within each native-price hour.
model_policy.delta_5_matrix: Physical plug IDs with five-minute changeovers.
model_policy.cost_comparison_basis: Equipment thresholds compare bills under fixed service and the evaluated dispatch policy.
